quotations.old_english: Ongeán módstaðolnysse and módes strencðe se mánfulla deófol sendeð wácmódnesse and lyðerne earhscype (base cowardice)

source_text: earg-scipe. Substitute: I. cowardice, pusillanimity. v. earg, I:--Ongeán módstaðolnysse and módes strencðe se mánfulla deófol sendeð wácmódnesse and lyðerne earhscype (base cowardice), Wlfst. 53, 12. II. profligacy. v. earg, II:--Þ-bar; wíf in argscipe begrippene mulierem in adulterio reprehensam, Jn. p. 5, 8. [Heo mid ærhscape arnden to heolde and letten slæn heore folc, Laym. 12411. Icel. arg-skapr cowardice.]
